findings.title: Stats page crashes and stays on 'Loading stats…' with the previous range's table when the stats response is not in the expected shape
findings.expected: An error message such as 'Could not load harvest stats.', no uncaught error, and the old table not shown as the result for the new range
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'. The page keeps showing 'Loading stats…' with the old 1 Jan to 31 Dec table under From = 2026-07-01, and no error is shown
findings.evidence: {"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"alerts":["Loading stats…"],"text":["From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View"]} | {"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"alerts":["Loading stats…"],"text":["From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View"]}

findings.title: A stats request that hangs leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen forever, above the old range's results
findings.expected: The request times out with a visible error, or the old results are clearly marked as out of date
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still shows 'Loading stats…' with no timeout or error, and the table and best plants from the previous range stay visible under the new From date
